discovery: Development of massively parallel next-generation DNA sequencing using reversible-terminator sequencing-by-synthesis chemistry (Solexa/Illumina)
rationale: Recent Chemistry prizes went to materials and protein work: MOFs in 2025 and protein design/structure prediction in 2024. That makes a return to chemical biology likely. Solexa sequencing-by-synthesis rests on fluorescent reversible-terminator nucleotide chemistry and cluster amplification on surfaces. It changed genomics and medicine, it is mature and widely used, and it has already won major precursor awards such as the 2020 Breakthrough Prize and the Millennium Technology Prize. Its inventors are frequently named in Nobel Chemistry forecasts.
